core_meaning.short_meaning: Hagar; she who emigrated, one who migrates
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hajira corresponds to the Arabic form هاجرة (Arabic root ه ج ر (h-j-r); هاجرة (hājira)). Its core sense is hagar; she who emigrated, one who migrates. Hajira is the feminine form هاجرة (hājira) from the root ه ج ر 'to emigrate' — 'she who emigrates; one who has made the Hijra'. The source gloss 'emigrant or companion' captures the sense. Same name family as haajar, hagir, hajir.
